note: ADR 0905 (C2): two corpus sweeps of the frozen rc.21 apps with --manifest scripts/corpus/rc21-manifest.json. (1) commit at the frozen apps root against baseline at the same root: expect relabels only (census blockers), V unchanged; list every moved row. (2) commit at a second root (a copy of the same apps under another directory name) against (1): expect byte-identical rows after relativizing paths; any difference is a path-dependent choice, list its rows with code, blocker and pass. Use a second root whose path differs from the first, ideally by name and length.
